items.description: Rage at Shop 27, Savannah Mall, is a fashion and footwear store selling shoes and clothing for women, as well as men's and kids' shoes. The brand describes itself as a go-to stylist for every occasion and says it has built a strong, solid reputation in the South African retail market over the past two decades. Its styles are aimed at women young and old, with footwear for men and children alongside. The store says it will gladly exchange an item for a bigger or smaller size, and if a production flaw turns up, the item can be brought back within six months with the original slip for an exchange. Savannah Mall lists the store in its Fashion and Footwear section.

items.description: UmaLearning is an online learning platform based at 192 Outspan Drive, Bendor Park, Polokwane, offering e-learning for school learners from Grade 1 to Grade 12. The content is aligned to the CAPS and IEB curricula, and learners can watch lessons, revise difficult topics and prepare for exams, with every school subject available in one place. The platform works on any mobile device or computer, with 24/7 access, online remote learning and expert trainers, and it also advertises corporate partnerships. Membership is listed at R250 a month or R3,000 a year. Parents can use it to help children with homework, assignments, revision and exam preparation without searching for separate resources.

items.description: Foschini at Shop U37, Mall of the North in Bendor, is a fashion retailer for women, men and kids. The mall's own page invites shoppers to browse the latest fashion trends at the store. Foschini belongs to TFG Limited, which describes the brand as offering smart and casual wear, denim, leisurewear, accessories, lingerie, footwear, cosmetics and fine jewellery. The store trades from 9am to 7pm on weekdays and from 9am to 5pm on weekends and public holidays. The branch is a good fit for shoppers in Polokwane who want clothing and accessories for the whole family in one store, and Foschini products are also sold online through the Bash shopping platform.

Fridge Repairs is an appliance repair service at 68 Market Street, Polokwane Central, serving residents and businesses in Polokwane and the wider Limpopo region. An independent appliance-repair directory describes it as focused on domestic and light commercial refrigeration, handling fridges, freezers and related systems rather than large industrial appliances. Typical jobs include diagnosing and repairing poor cooling, inconsistent temperature control, noisy compressors or fans, worn door seals and frost build-up, with faulty components repaired or replaced where needed. The aim is to restore cooling performance and extend the useful life of the appliance. It suits households and small businesses whose fridge or freezer has stopped keeping things cold.

items.description: Markham at Shop U37a, Mall of the North in Bendor, is a men's fashion store. The mall describes it as the place to find everything you need to look your best, from suits and shirts to jeans and shoes. Markham is a men's fashion retail chain that sells jeans, smart wear, accessories, footwear and gadgets, and it started in Cape Town. TFG Limited, the group behind the brand, describes the range as on-trend smart and casual wear, including footwear, accessories and fragrances. The store trades from 9am to 7pm on weekdays and from 9am to 5pm on weekends and public holidays. It suits men looking for work wear, weekend casuals and formal outfits.
